messages:
ashley: eval-bot just flagged a regression on pset7 from last night's run — overall F1 down 0.87 -> 0.74, neg-case failure spike. can we triage?

eval-bot: nightly-evals/pset7: FAIL (delta -0.13). top failing examples attached. run_id=2026-05-12_03:15

sara: putting a quick diff together. i think the recent wording tweak removed an explicit constraint for hallucination avoidance.

ashley: can you paste the diff? small prompt changes can have big semantic effects.

sara: sure — removed this line in prompt_v7: ```
Please answer concisely and do not invent facts.
```
Now prompt asks to be "concise" but loses the no-invent constraint.

matt: ahh. that makes sense with the hallucination increase. any sample outputs?

ashley: sample: input about a company acquisition -> model asserts acquisition with fabricated date and source. this was rare before, now ~12% more hallucinations on relevant items.

liam: two choices: revert to prompt_v6 (rollback) or rebaseline pset with updated expected outputs (accept new behavior). rebaseline risk = accepts hallucinations as ground truth; i'd rather revert.

carol: +1 to revert. production customers expect factuality. can we perform a quick canary rollback on dedicated canary pool?

ashley: I can push a rollback canary today. plan: 1) deploy pset6 prompts to canary model (canary-1) 2) run full nightly eval subset + 1k live-sim requests 3) compare latency/cost — if good, promote to prod rollback.

sara: i'll run a focused A/B on the 500 failing cases to confirm reduction in hallucinations.

liam: schedule? we should block any automated merges to prompt-pack until triage cleared.

matt: blocking merges now. also tagging support to watch user reports window.

eval-bot: canary-run scheduled: canary-1 with prompt_v6 at 2026-05-12T14:00Z. automated diff will post after run.

ashley: thanks. approvals: carol? sara? liam? need a thumbs.

carol: :thumbsup: go ahead.

sara: :thumbsup:

liam: :thumbsup: locking prompt pack branch until we confirm.

ashley: executing rollback canary now — will post results when eval-bot returns.

eval-bot: canary-report: pset7 subset F1 restored to 0.86, hallucination rate down to baseline. no perf regressions observed. artifacts: link to diff and aggregated examples.

matt: excellent. proceed with revert PR and merge freeze lift when rollout completes.

ashley: opened PR #4823 to revert prompt_v7 -> prompt_v6. tagging @eng-oncall for rollout window.

liam: will coordinate canary->prod during 02:00-04:00 PST maintenance window.

ashley: closing loop: decision = rollback prompt_v7. rebaseline not approved. follow-up todo: add an eval test asserting presence of an explicit anti-hallucination constraint in prompts, and add a changelog checklist item for semantic prompt intent.

matt: agree — added to product checklist. thanks everyone.

carol: nice fast triage, team. :sparkles:
